Bash(node -e "const gdal = require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('GDAL version:', gdal.version\); const ds = gdal.open\('D:/TIFF/clutter-india-25m.tif'\); console.log\('opened:', ds.rasterSize.x, 'x', ds.rasterSize.y, 'bands=' + ds.bands.count\(\), 'srs=' + \(ds.srs ? ds.srs.getAuthorityCode\(\) : 'none'\)\); ds.close\(\);")

Bash(ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron -e "try { const gdal = require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('LOADED via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, GDAL version:', gdal.version\); const ds = gdal.open\('D:/TIFF/clutter-india-25m.tif'\); console.log\('opened:', ds.rasterSize.x, 'x', ds.rasterSize.y, 'bands=' + ds.bands.count\(\), 'srs=' + ds.srs.getAuthorityCode\(\)\); ds.close\(\); console.log\('OK'\); } catch\(e\) { console.error\('FAILED:', e.message\); process.exit\(1\); }")

Bash(node -e "const g=require\('gdal-async'\); console.log\('GDAL', g.version\); const drivers=[]; for \(let i=0;i<g.drivers.count\(\);i++\){drivers.push\(g.drivers.get\(i\).description\);} console.log\('WEBP available:', drivers.includes\('WEBP'\)\); console.log\('All drivers:', drivers.filter\(d => d.match\(/PNG|WEBP|JPEG/i\)\).join\(', '\)\);")
